description: Python tools installed and managed via uv tool install or run with uvx

tools.description: Compose provider for `podman compose` — reads compose.yaml and drives the Podman CLI directly (daemonless, rootless-native). uv tool install puts a `podman-compose` executable on PATH, which `podman compose` / `just containers` resolve as their provider.
An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust - replaces flake8, black, isort and more.
An extremely fast Python type checker, written in Rust - from the makers of ruff and uv.
A library and CLI app for rendering project templates with Jinja2.
Browser automation library for end-to-end testing and web scraping - supports Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

AI-powered background removal for images — uses U2-Net models for clean portrait freistellung. The pymatting floor is load-bearing: rembg also accepts pymatting 1.1.14, which drags in a numba that refuses to build on any Python from 3.10 up.
Pretty-print git repository contributor statistics — commits, lines of code and file distribution per author. Drives the `git fame` alias.
Rewrite git history — remove files, redact secrets, extract subdirectories. The sanctioned successor to filter-branch; git picks it up as `git filter-repo` from the PATH.
Web-based interactive development environment for notebooks, code and data — the lab UI of Project Jupyter.
CLI to talk to language models — prompts, templates and plugins from the shell. Config and plugins live under LLM_USER_PATH.
Rich-CLI provides a command-line interface to render markdown, JSON, CSV and more with syntax highlighting in the terminal.
